children: has signed a deal worth up to €1.165B ($1.3B) with Swedish drug-delivery platform company Nanexa for access to its proprietary drug-delivery technology.

Under the agreement, Novo will receive a global exclusive license to Nanexa’s PharmaShell atomic layer deposition technology platform for certain therapeutic peptide drugs targeting obesity, type 2 diabetes, and other cardiometabolic diseases.
The deal covers up to five development programs and includes different administration-frequency profiles, with monthly and quarterly dosing among the targeted options.

Novo will lead global development and commercialization of the programs. Nanexa is eligible for €615M in upfront payments and development and regulatory milestones, with total potential payments under the agreement reaching €1.165B.
In addition, the agreement provides for low single-digit royalties on future product sales.

title: Novo signs up to $1.3B deal for Nanexa drug-delivery technology
